findings.summary: The global architecture evolved from four to six products while datapasscontrol still contained older four-product language.
findings.action: dataprojects is now global authority; datapasscontrol README/AGENTS point to it.

findings.summary: Several canonical implementations live on long-lived feature branches rather than main.
Fabric Ops main is upstream-like while major custom work lives on branches 170-185 commits ahead, so reading main alone gives a false project state.
findings.action: Mark integration branch as authoritative or merge a clean release line.

findings.summary: FOIL Databricks DAB feature branches are behind main while still ahead with unique commits.
findings.action: Reconcile/retire to avoid agents restarting from stale feature branches.

findings.summary: Interview curriculum exists in multiple independently polished products with their own tests/releases, creating repeated UX and content work.
findings.action: Canonicalize Datapass/CaseLab and convert other apps to source/donor/consumer status.

findings.summary: FactoryLab already has rich donor UI and backend but lacks a canonical standalone repo, encouraging repeated greenfield starts.
findings.action: Duckle spike then create/assign canonical FactoryLab repo immediately.

findings.summary: PBI/Semantic Lab is conceptually approved but not assigned a canonical repo, while PbiBench and TabularEditor_J continue to exist as capable codebases.
findings.action: Choose extraction strategy before new semantic-model UI work.
